title: Winter Wonderland Clipart Set
author: Safiul Designs
description:
Step into a peaceful Winter Wonderland with this charming collection of cozy snowy cottage illustrations. Featuring beautifully detailed snow-covered houses, evergreen trees, frosty bushes, red berries, glowing windows, and festive wreaths, this set captures the warmth and magic of a quiet Christmas village.
Each illustration combines a rustic storybook cottage style with soft winter textures, creating a cozy atmosphere filled with snowy rooftops, warm lights, woodland greenery, and traditional Christmas colors. The natural brown, evergreen, snowy white, and rich red palette makes these designs especially versatile for seasonal crafting.
Perfect for Christmas T-shirts, sublimation, mugs, tumblers, stickers, greeting cards, invitations, ornaments, gift tags, Christmas décor, scrapbook pages, journals, planners, printable artwork, signs, and handmade holiday gifts.
This collection is also ideal for winter wonderland themes, Christmas cottage décor, rustic holiday projects, farmhouse Christmas designs, cozy winter crafts, and storybook-inspired seasonal creations.
✨ Collection Features
Beautiful snowy Christmas cottage illustrations
Cozy winter house and village-inspired designs
Snow-covered rooftops and frosty landscapes
Evergreen pine trees and winter foliage
Red berry branches and seasonal greenery
Warm glowing windows for a cozy atmosphere
Festive Christmas wreath details
Rustic storybook-inspired artwork
Soft watercolor-style textures
Classic red, green, brown, and snowy white palette
High-quality PNG clipart
Transparent backgrounds
35 PNG files
300 DPI high resolution
Suitable for personal and commercial creative projects
Bring the peaceful feeling of a snowy Christmas village and cozy winter cottage into your next holiday project.
